name: Basni Nifl'helja: Kniga Cygan
source:
Ruff and his brothers went to haymaking one day. His brothers punished him — do not lie down in the heat on the boundary under a broom bush. Did not listen to the brothers Ruff. This is where his misadventures began.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，拉夫和兄弟们去割草。兄弟们告诫他：“大热天别躺在地界边的金雀花丛下。”拉夫没有听从，于是他的倒霉事就此开始。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928650/]Steam[/url]]
